findings: Imaging sufficient but not ideal for SPC; northern coverage poorest. Publisher approximately15m/pixel best and2800m/pixel worst image-centre sampling are source statements, not new raster computations.
Nearly90 images in some regions do not establish independent useful high-resolution maplets.
True gap near270 longitude60 latitude leaves radius unconstrained; polar pixelation can also be a display artifact.
Q512300m GSD can oversample500m maplets near315 longitude-60 latitude; Q1281.195km GSD still oversamples northern data.
Sigma measures internal consistency. Missing single-maplet sigma is not zero uncertainty. Publisher inference of one–two maplet GSD accuracy is not independently reproduced.
Black reliability boundaries in radius and relative-albedo panels mark equatorward reliable and poleward suspect regions; no blanket global accuracy or visible-colour calibration.
Relative-albedo page title/caption and Radius (meters) legend conflict; preserve publisher label inconsistency without interpreting albedo as dimensional radius.
